stock.description: New Universe Environmental Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily dedicated to providing a wide array of environmental waste treatment and disposal services throughout the People's Republic of China. The company specializes in managing and treating both general and hazardous industrial waste for various chemical-related industries, as well as handling regulated medical waste from hospitals and clinics. Its service portfolio also encompasses chemical tank truck cleansing, the operation of solid waste landfills for general industrial refuse and environmentally sound post-incineration materials, and environmental industrial sewage and sludge treatment. Additionally, New Universe offers environmental technical consultancy, engineering, and management expertise. The company is involved in environmental plating sewage treatment within a specialized eco-plating zone, invests in the plastic materials dyeing sector, and holds real estate assets. Founded in 1996 and based in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong, the company was formerly known as New Universe International Group Limited, adopting its current name in May 2016.
